name: Oil flask
description: Lamp oil in a stoppered clay flask. Throw it and anything nearby becomes keen to catch fire.
notes: A stoppered flask of lamp oil to throw (mw-e17.6). It flies and lands as a flammable liquid (the oil material: ignites at 210 °C, burns 60 s), so a torch, a fire arrow or any flame sets it and what it lies against alight through the e03 fire rules. Grey-box; tuned with the final kits in m2/m3.
